title: RECURSIVE_CJT_STATE_SCHEMA_v0_1
description: Typed Bias state for the RC-0 controller. B_{j,t} = (S, M, P_RPM, Z, Theta, G). P_RPM is the RPM prerequisite state (NEVER resistance; lower-case r is reserved for CAS-Ohm resistance). The transition function is named CJTStep, never J (J is reserved for Jacobians in the eta-epsilon lane). BiasState is immutable; the only path to B_{j,t+1} is a BiasUpdateIntent committed atomically by the TransactionCoordinator. Status: PROPOSED_UNTESTED design schema; reference implementation sim/rc0_types.py.

rpm_state.description: P_RPM: prerequisite state. D/W/P are independent raw values - never one simplex; only the DEFICIT vector may normalize for bottleneck attribution.

acquired.description: cached satisfied prerequisites (one-directional, Correction 2); invalidated only by explicit events

operating_record.description: Z: factorized two-axis operating record. region_posterior is Delta^3 over EXACTLY the four source-defined regions. non_ohmic/unstable are separate statuses, NOT regions. ASOM is a DERIVED dashboard letter, never stored as authority.

region_posterior.description: POSTERIOR over (cutoff, active, saturation, breakdown); sums to 1.

semantic_outcome.description: Written ONLY by the verifier. Region arithmetic never writes this.

governance.description: G: hard typed permissions. Owner-only; BiasUpdateIntents may not touch it.

hard_mask.description: Absolute permission. NEVER a resistance; a large V cannot outvote it.

compute_budget.note: Frozen single unit for the first experiment. B_t = maximum CJT expert executions permitted this episode; B_{j,t} = B_t * g_{j,t}. Repairs cost 1 unit each. Tokens, FLOPs, tool calls, and milliseconds are NOT interchangeable with this unit; each later unit requires its own registered calibration profile.

route_equation.score: score_j,t = hard_mask(G_j,t) * rpm_ready_j,t * route_multiplier(region_j,t-1) * V_j,t / (r_j,t + epsilon)
route_equation.route_multiplier: scalar in [0,1], pure function of the LAST COMMITTED region Z_{t-1}
route_equation.control_action: separate typed enum {RUN, CAP, SPLIT, REPAIR, QUARANTINE, HALT}; never enters arithmetic
route_equation.all_zero: sum of scores == 0 -> NO_READY_CJT (never divide by zero); RPM opens a repair subgoal or the kernel halts

D.source: declared per-expert Desire value (first experiment: scenario-declared; later: Drive/goal state readout)
D.dual_role: hard relevance threshold (readiness, tau_D) AND above-threshold surplus supplies V = max(0, D - tau_D) (routing). The same deficiency is never counted twice: below threshold the gate closes and V contributes nothing further.

W.source: declared per-expert Wisdom value (first experiment: scenario-declared; later: applicability assessment)
W.note: Readiness-only. Wisdom is NOT a resistance component in RC-0 (non-duplication contract).

P.source: declared per-expert Power value (first experiment: scenario-declared; later: capability assessment)
P.dual_role: hard minimum-capability threshold (readiness, tau_P) AND above-threshold value MAY modulate r_cap (routing). RC-0 simulator keeps r_cap fixed; the modulation hook is registered, not active.

r_cap.source: declared capacity constraint (later: measured capability resistance)

hard_policy_mask.note: Policy is a hard mask, NEVER a resistance. Quarantine zeroes the effective mask.

region_evidence.source: observed usage/readiness during EXECUTE-OBSERVE (consecutive-use counter, readiness at execution)
region_evidence.note: Region evidence NEVER includes the semantic outcome (two-axis discipline).
